merge_dicts: merge multiple dictionaries of random variable samples into a single stacked or concatenated dictionary
safe_log_prob_sum: compute the log probability sum of a distribution for a value, returning negative infinity for out-of-support values
seed: set a random seed across PyTorch, Python random, and NumPy for reproducible inference results
detach_samples: detach PyTorch tensors from a samples dictionary and convert them to NumPy arrays
verify_queries_and_observations: validate that queries and observations meet the inference contract before running probabilistic inference
